answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 37026 Country: India Title: From some time from now I have started getting evil thoughts and word. Satan comes in my mind very much Question: From some time from now I have started getting evil thoughts and word. Satan comes in my mind very much. These word keep echoing in my mind from time to time or can say almost every time what should I do? Please guide me this is like a hell situation for me. I bring in mind the punishment which I will get for taking satan's name in mind too but I cannot get any help. Please help me, writing this to you as a last hope. Answer ID: 37026 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 539/262/L=1433) Recite the holy Quran and لا حول extensively. In-shaAllah, with the blessings of it the bad thoughts shall vanish. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
